name: Mosaic Tender
lore: An axolotl gardener who grows living tiles. Five pieces can fight separately or, when the area is quiet, assemble into one colourful guardian. Split them again to surround a target.

primary.name: Living Tile
primary.description: Summon a living tile. Click an enemy within 600 reach to mark it: your tiles prioritize that foe. Five pieces normally; a merged guardian can have two extra single companions. Small tiles last 14s; merged tiles gain 3s per extra piece (up to 26s).
primary.ui_brief: Summon + mark target • guardian + 2 small companions

secondary.name: Scatter Pattern
secondary.description: Split merged tiles into their original pieces without restoring health. All tiles gain +35% movement speed and +40% attack speed for 4s, even if none need splitting. Rally toward your aim; merging waits 6s.

special.name: Bubble Bloom
special.description: Hold up to 1.2s, then release five bubbles in a fan. Each deals 9–14.4 damage on contact and leaves a 3-second slowing splash when it pops. No minions required.
special.ui_brief: Charged bubble fan • contact damage + slow splashes

passive: Tessellated Steps: Your tiles move 15 faster without changing the five-piece capacity.

technique.name: Protective Pattern

attack.name: Protective Pattern
attack.description: Give your existing tiles 30% damage reduction for 3s. Does not split or rally them.

technique.description: Replace Scatter with short companion protection.

final_technique.name: Shatter Parade

attack.name: Shatter Parade
attack.description: Your tiles rush the aimed point and burst for 15 damage per piece, then disappear. No empowered guardian remains.

final_technique.description: Spend all pieces on delayed bursts instead of the bubble volley.
